SELECT ?zone ?tempsys ?sp WHERE {

  ?t a brick:Air_Temperature ; brick:hasSubComponent ?zone .
  ?t ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tempsys .
  ?sp a brick:Air_Cooling_Setpoint ; brick:hasSubComponent ?zone .
  ?sp ref:hasTimeseriesId ?spsys .
}

SELECT DISTINCT ?class WHERE { ?p a ?class . FILTER (regex(str(?class), "Setpoint|Temperature", "i")) }
